answer.reason: The verses tell of Tatnai questioning the Jews' building, writing to Darius, and then obeying Darius's decree.

clauses.english: questioned the Jews about who had commanded them to build the house
clauses.quote: Who hath commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?

clauses.english: sent a letter to King Darius about the building of the house

clauses.quote: according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily

doubts: The name is spelled Tatnai in the verses; the summary calls him Tattenai.
